title: Evidence-Aligned Benchmarking and Learning for Medical Video Language Models
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: A medical video language model should answer from the visual evidence its question asks about.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: First, benchmarks reward answers that ignore the video: on one dataset, the position of a clip within its recording predicts the surgical step in 37% of questions, and a constant answer beats every trained model on a standard safety-assessment metric.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We build MedVidBench-v2, 34 tasks from 18 surgical and clinical video datasets, in which prompts and metrics are audited with answers given without video, and which tests unseen hospitals and windows cut blindly from whole recordings.
